name: ctrl-duration-pruning
question: Do longer training and training-time large-Gaussian pruning change validation quality, separately?
gate: run only if camera_check.md shows coherent cameras (reprojection consistent with SfM, no dimension, intrinsics or pose anomaly) and train-full renders do not reveal an input defect
design: 2 x 2 factorial: duration {3000, 10000} x pruning {s0: none, s1: large-Gaussian pruning 1100-2400}
held_constant: prepared inputs: one prep run for all arms
learning rates and position decay (over 3000 steps, then constant)
prep_run: salon-gsplat-007 (new preparation at the current commit; same partition and sources)
reference: salon-gsplat-006 / l4-short-001 kept intact; ctrl-3k-s0 is its replicate and measures run-to-run variation

metrics.primary: mean validation PSNR over usable faces at step 3000 (all arms) and at the last step
secondary: per-region validation PSNR (glass, mirror, unvalidated reflective, furniture, contours, other)
same metrics on the inspected train faces
Gaussian count, large Gaussians, out-of-box Gaussians

reading.duration effect: 10k vs 3k with the same pruning (s0 and s1); also final vs step 3000 inside a 10k arm
reading.pruning effect: s1 vs s0 at the same duration

quality_thresholds: none: differences are reported with the replicate as noise reference
